gloss: to support, to nourish, to cultivate

definitions.explanation: To financially or materially support someone, especially family members.
To provide sustenance or care for growth and development.
To develop a skill, ability, or quality over time.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}を{養|やしな}うために{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: I work to support my family.

examples.japanese: {体力|たいりょく}を{養|やしな}う。
examples.english: I build up my physical strength.

examples.japanese: {読書|どくしょ}で{教養|きょうよう}を{養|やしな}う。
examples.english: I cultivate my education through reading.

notes:
{養|やしな}う has meanings related to support, nourishment, and cultivation.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {家族|かぞく}を{養|やしな}う: to support one's family
- {力|ちから}を{養|やしな}う: to build up one's strength
- {教養|きょうよう}を{養|やしな}う: to cultivate one's education
- {目|め}を{養|やしな}う: to develop an eye for (something)

RELATED WORDS:
- {育|そだ}てる: to raise, bring up
- {扶養|ふよう}する: to support (formal)
- {栄養|えいよう}: nutrition

[Register: Neutral]
